subject: general
question: Which of the following energies reflect mechanical energy when combined?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Potential energy and kinetic energy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mechanical energy** is the sum of potential energy and kinetic energy present in the components of a mechanical system.
 
• **Potential energy** is the energy stored in an object due to its position or configuration.
 
• **Kinetic energy** is the energy an object possesses due to its motion.
 
• Mechanical energy is conserved in a closed system where no external forces like friction act.
 
• Examples include a swinging pendulum, a coiled spring, and a moving vehicle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Potential Energy**

 
 
• Includes gravitational potential energy and elastic potential energy.
 
• Gravitational potential energy depends on the height and mass of an object.
 
• Elastic potential energy is stored when materials stretch or compress.
 
 
 
• **Kinetic Energy**
 
 
• Depends on the mass and velocity of an object.
 
• Formula: K.E. = 0.5 * mass * velocity².
 
 
 
• **Law of Conservation of Energy**
 
 
• States that energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed from one form to another.
 
• In a frictionless system, mechanical energy remains constant.
 
 
 
• **Mechanical Systems**
 
 
• Include any system where potential and kinetic energy are present and interact.
 
• Examples: roller coasters, pendulums, and engines.
